accounting_review.root: The initial row charge still pays for outer port/reference/body-size traversal before nested length counts are read. equalityFields counts owner/value IDs, array headers, every axis, and a tag plus at most one parameter per basis atom. aligned still performs complete interface/body/child equality. It does not run sideValid or uniqueness, so quadratic sideCharge is not needed for that comparison. The minimum with the old charge retains its budget upper bound, including the empty-frame equality case. Computing both costs adds only length-only outer scans, covered by the initial and conservative factor16 allowances; there is no second semantic matching attempt on fallback.
accounting_review.preparation: Keep headerCharge, factor64 and the original (1+fresh.size) multiplier for request/fresh/output comparisons. Each actual definition contributes its complete input/output sideCharge once to the summed steps term; project and step inspect that definition a bounded number of times. All frame typing, uniqueness, disjointness, effect, initialization, ordering and header equality checks still run. Avoid multiplying this already summed per-definition work by all unrelated fresh allocations.
accounting_review.readout: Keep headerCharge, factor64 and (1+owners.size+pack.size) on request/output work. That multiplier still covers owner lookup, output membership filtering, owner uniqueness, and ordered pack comparisons. Each definition is projected and checked once by the corresponding pass, with its complete input/output frame validity and uniqueness charged by the summed steps term. Every original valid/step predicate is unchanged.
accounting_review.budget_compatibility: Private min-le-original theorems ensure none of these charges exceeds its former value. Native fixtures additionally check the former accepted threshold, exact new threshold and threshold-minus-one. These are conservative checker-work accounting and acceptance-preservation facts, not a CPU-time or Resource Safety Theorem.
accounting_review.independence: Producer rewrites remain untrusted and separately tested on all small columns with phase/reference coefficients. Kernel acceptance, independent exact finite obligations and root request checking remain required. The baseline source request is recorded only for mutation regression, not as independent named QPE evidence.
